# Socilet - Zero Advance Web Development Agency

> Socilet is a professional web development agency based in India offering zero advance payment policy. We build websites, web apps, mobile apps, and digital solutions at competitive Indian market rates.

- Company: Socilet Digital Solutions

## Services Offered
- Website Development (Business, E-commerce, Portfolio, Landing Pages)
- Web Application Development (SaaS, CRM, Dashboards)
- Mobile App Development (Cross-platform, React Native)
- SEO Services (On-page, Off-page, Technical SEO)
- Google Ads Management (PPC Campaigns)
- Social Media Marketing
- AI Spokesperson Video Creation
- Google My Business (GMB) Profile Setup
- WordPress Development
- Automation Blogging Solutions
- Digital Product Reselling (Hosting, Domains at 60-90% discount)

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Supabase, Node.js
- CMS: WordPress
- Hosting: Vercel, AWS, DigitalOcean
- Database: PostgreSQL
- Other: Vite, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion

- Zero Advance Payment: No upfront cost, pay only after satisfaction
